problems: The arched top is a full elliptical cylinder. Its lower half sits in the same plane as the front of the box body, so a stray curved seam runs across the front of the cabinet from knob to knob. That reads as a crack or a second panel. Fix: flatten the lower half of the arch so it ends flush on the top of the box.
The wood uses the gloss finish, which makes the cabinet look like orange plastic. The rules ask for matte on wood.

The cabinet is two parts, a box with an arch set on top. Their rounded edges meet in a deep groove at z = 0.45, so the radio reads as a box with a lid. The arch's rounded cap edges also bulge past the box sides. Build the cabinet as one solid: warp the arch cylinder's lower rim down to the plinth, so the arched top and the straight sides are one piece with no seam.
